info.title: Dirty Pair (ITA)
info.synopsis: Anno 2141. Gli esseri umani si sono sparpagliati per l'universo e hanno colonizzato migliaia sistemi solari. La World Welfare Work Agency è una società che lavora per i pianeti che fanno parte dell'Unione Galattica e, dietro lauto compenso, si presta a risolvere qualsiasi tipo di caso, dalle indagini sui crimini più disparati, fino alla soluzione di problemi su scala planetaria. Lo svolgimento di questi incarichi viene affidato a degli agenti altamente specializzati chiamati Trouble Consultant. Se c'è un problema che nessuno può risolvere, la 3WA metterà a vostra disposizione due consulenti di prim'ordine: Kei e Yuri, nome in codice Lovely Angels. Nelle loro missioni vengono aiutate da Namu, un robot costruito dalle ragazze, e Mughi, una creatura con l'aspetto di un grosso e tranquillo gattone. Ben presto però le ragazze vengono soprannominate Dirty Pair (in italiano "le pestifere due") a causa del fatto che ogni missione a loro affidata si conclude con successo, ma con enormi danni collaterali.

episodes.title: Il computer impazzito
episodes.synopsis: A priceless prism is being delivered to Caine Galaxy. For safety, 20 different ships are being deployed, but only one of them has the actual gem. Kei and Yuri aren't sure if their cargo is real or not, but they must battle a group of pirates who intend to find out!

episodes.title: Sabotaggio
episodes.synopsis: Cosmo Plane Service has fallen victim to two suspicious accidents and now they're launching the Tenan I Spacecraft, their most expensive ship yet.

episodes.title: Il furto della moneta
episodes.synopsis: King, the leader of a crime syndicate on Planet Vega, holds the Golem Poker Chip, which brings good luck to anyone who owns it. The Lovely Angels are sent to infiltrate King's estate and bring the Chip back into the hands of the law!

episodes.title: Un gatto prezioso
episodes.synopsis: The Guillaume De Malatesta XIII cat has run away! He was the test subject for a muscle fortifier that grants superhuman strength. If the Dirty Pair can't find him soon the city could be leveled flat!

episodes.title: Ordine di esecuzione
episodes.synopsis: While traveling in a rental ship to one of Kei's hot dates, the Lovely Angels are set upon by an old enemy out for revenge from beyond the grave.

episodes.title: Un carico pericoloso
episodes.synopsis: Kei and Yuri must defend a precious stone prism shipment against pirates.

episodes.title: Il rapimento
episodes.synopsis: Clicky is the sole heir to the wealthy Goldjeff empire. He's eloping with a woman named Joanca, but she has plans to kidnap him and walk away with millions of credits in ransom money. It's up to the Dirty Pair to step in and set things right!

episodes.title: Una vecchia promessa
episodes.synopsis: Yuri receives a shocking message from Billy Galet, her childhood sweetheart who promised her a spaceship. Now Yuri wants to retire and leaves with Billy, but Kei won't give up so easily.

episodes.title: Due bande rivali
episodes.synopsis: Newstone Ore is a highly sought-after source of fuel, but fighting between two rival syndicates has lead to a drop in the supply. The Dirty Pair are sent in disguised as the feisty Shooting Star Okei and the beautiful sharpshooter Crimson Oyuri!

episodes.title: Proteggete il principe!
episodes.synopsis: Beloved King Louis VII, ruler of Planet Caspia, has died. If anything befalls his only son, Prince Heace, the throne will default to the villainous Duke Ruber. The Queen has called in the Dirty Pair to ensure the Prince's safe return.

episodes.title: Un appuntamento a sorpresa
episodes.synopsis: Kei and Yuri have received a dinner invitation from the handsome G.A. Frances. But when they stop by Planet Cauld for a little pre-dinner dress shopping, the police aren't too happy to see them.

episodes.title: La rivolta dei topi
episodes.synopsis: Algernon has been stolen! The thief is in the 3WA building and the Dirty Pair are called to smoke him out, but no one will tell them what exactly was stolen, or who stole it. How can they find something if they don't know what they're looking for?

episodes.title: Il mostro del sottosuolo
episodes.synopsis: Something lurking in the sewers is eating Eleanor City residents. Much to the chagrin of the Tower Chief, the Dirty Pair are back to save the day.

episodes.title: Pandora
episodes.synopsis: Security is tight at 3WA Headquarters, for two reasons: Presidential candidate Guilder is there for a speech, and maintenance is underway on Pandora's Vault. But a shadowy figure sneaks in and the Dirty Pair must find out what they're after: Guilder or Pandora.

episodes.title: Un antico tesoro
episodes.synopsis: An old coot by the name of Joe says he's on the trail of an enormous treasure! Catch is, it's in the deepest, darkest part of the ruins.

episodes.title: Giochi politici
episodes.synopsis: Sakurako Yorozuya may look like an ordinary young woman, but she's actually the head of a giant corporation! Kei and Yuri have been assigned to protect her, but babysitting this naive, high-society princess turns out to be a royal pain in the rear.

episodes.title: Il buco nero
episodes.synopsis: Sundric, a brilliant cryptanalyst and deadly assassin, has eluded the 3WA for thirteen years, but they have one last chance to catch him. The Dirty Pair go undercover as Flight Attendant Yuri and Sister Kei to smoke him out!

episodes.title: Servizio di scorta
episodes.synopsis: The Dirty Pair arrest a difficult character, but getting him to the police station is even more complicated.

episodes.title: Uno strano incarico
episodes.synopsis: Kei and Yuri are sent to avenge the "murder" of an eccentric millionaire's romantic interest, a doll. It's going to be tricky though as they already know who dropped a space pod on the doll's head.

episodes.title: Vendetta!
episodes.synopsis: The Dirty Pair are looking for an assassin who has gone to ground. Unfortunately they end up owing him a favour.

episodes.title: Il mistero dei passeggeri scomparsi
episodes.synopsis: A passenger spaceship on a routine flight arrives in port with nobody aboard.

episodes.title: Il ricatto
episodes.synopsis: Arthur admits his part in the disappearance mystery, but his plan has been hijacked by the pilots to their own ends.

episodes.title: La truffa
episodes.synopsis: Yuri is injured when the 3WA pull them off a drugs job at the last moment, but is helped by a charming con man.

episodes.title: Il maniaco omicida
episodes.synopsis: A door-to-door salesman serial killer is on the loose, and the Dirty Pair are assigned to be a honeypot to catch him.

info.title: Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World?
info.synopsis: Nel mondo esistono cinque grandi razze, di cui l'umanità non è che la più debole; nonostante ciò, grazie alla guida del cosiddetto "Sid il Profeta", gli esseri umani sono riusciti a sconfiggere le altre razze e a prendere il controllo del pianeta. Da 100 anni, quindi, le quattro fazioni sconfitte sono sigillate all'interno di altrettante piramidi sparse per il mondo. Un giorno, tuttavia, la realtà viene riscritta: Kai, un giovane soldato, sembra essere l'unico ad avere memoria della vittoria dell'umanità. Nella nuova realtà demoni e draghi hanno il controllo della Terra e Sid non sembra essere mai esistito; come se non bastasse, nessun essere umano, neanche i suoi amici d'infanzia, sembra conoscere Kai. Dopo aver incontrato la misteriosa e bellissima Rinne, tuttavia, il ragazzo decide di ripristinare la realtà che conosceva: sarà Kai, in un mondo senza eroi, ad ereditarne il ruolo e a sfidare nuovamente le altre razze.

episodes.title: The Boy Forgotten by the World
episodes.synopsis: Kai's duty as a member of the Human Protection Agency is to ensure that the four races from The Great War are kept sealed in their graveyards. Humanity has been at peace for 100 years, until one day a portal opens and the world he's known ceases to exist.

episodes.title: Rinne
episodes.synopsis: In the graveyard where the demons were entombed in his world, Kai finds a girl whom he cannot identify as any of the known races. When she asks him for help, he doesn't hesitate for long. After freeing her from her chains, mysterious things happen again.

episodes.title: The Hero of the Demons
episodes.synopsis: After the demon attack on Neo Vishal, the resistance launches a major offensive against the demons and their heroine with the help of Kai and Rinne. But will Kai's knowledge from his world and Rinne's powers be enough to defeat the demons?

episodes.title: Thus, the World Was Recorded
episodes.synopsis: While Kai and Rinne confront the heroine of the demons, one of those mysterious beings reappears and tries to remove Vanessa from the world. However, Vanessa manages to fight it off. She then turns her attention back to Kai and Rinne.

episodes.title: To the East of the World
episodes.synopsis: After finally driving the demons out of the capital, Urza's resistance sets out for the Federation of Io, whose resistance has requested support against the divine beings. However, it quickly becomes clear that not everyone welcomes this support.

episodes.title: Elven Forest
episodes.synopsis: Jeanne and Urza's resistance encounter remnants of the Io resistance in the Elfan Forest. Following the trail, they arrive at the Elf Village, where the leader of the elves is already waiting to present them with a proposal.

episodes.title: Heartless Angel
episodes.synopsis: Urza's resistance, along with Reiren, confronts the Lord of the Heavens, Alfreya, who is attempting to subjugate the divine beings. However, Alfreya appears to possess powers that surpass even those of a hero.

episodes.title: Celestial Purgatory
episodes.synopsis: Once again, a Last Riser seems to be connected to the sudden change in a hero's nature. Will Kai and his companions be able to defeat Alfreya? And what impact will this have on the relationship between humans and the divine beings?

episodes.title: The Center of the World
episodes.synopsis: The spirit hero, "Spirit Sovereign Rikugen Kyoko" and the mythical beast hero, "Fang King Rath=IE" face off, with the fate of their races in the balance. Meanwhile, Kai and his companions head south to the Yulun Federation.

episodes.title: The Prophet of This World
episodes.synopsis: Guided by a mysterious voice, Kai, Rinne, and Jeanne enter Megalith. Awaiting them at the end is a stone statue of The Prophetic God Arsla Solaka. Kai is confused as he thought the Prophetic God was nothing more than a legend.

episodes.title: To Where Fate Lies
episodes.synopsis: The resistance gets into a battle against the heroine of the spirit beings, but in the midst of it, a Last Riser appears. After the battle, they decide to get to the bottom of the mystery of the Last Risers. And so they proceed to the next tomb.

episodes.title: Those Who Shatter the Endless Cycle of World Reincarnation
episodes.synopsis: A battle begins between Last Riser and Kai with Kyoko’s aid. Rinne, frozen out of fear, recalls her past with Sid. They manage to lure the monster out of the graveyard as all the races join forces to defeat one enemy; The enemy of the world, Last Riser.

info.title: Shin Chan (ITA)
info.synopsis: Ambientata a Kasukabe, nella prefettura di Saitama, questa serie racconta le avventure di Shinnosuke Nohara, detto Shin-chan, un bambino di cinque anni che combina un sacco guai coinvolgendo, nelle sue monellate, i genitori, la sorella minore e i compagni di scuola.

episodes.title: Doing Errands / Mama`s Mornings Are Busy! / Doodling!
episodes.synopsis:
Misae forgets to buy some ingredients for dinner that she is cooking for a special guest (a client of Hiroshi), so she asks Shin to go get them for her. But Shin makes this task more complicated than it should. It was later revealed that Hiroshi's client had to cancel the dinner.

Shin-chan acts lazy to wake up and go to school because of which, he misses his bus all the time. Misae gets angry on him.

Shin-chan and his friends learn drawing in school. Shin-chan finds faults in others, but fails in it himself. His teacher helps him draw a plane.

episodes.title: Tricycles Are Fun / My Stomach Is Going to Burst / A Nightmare for Dad
episodes.synopsis:
After much hesitation, Misae gives Shin a tricycle to play with. When he accidentally drops it into a dirty lake, Misae tries to find it. While this is happening, Shin runs off, making Misae think that she's been a bad parent, but it's revealed that Shin ran off because "Action Mask" was starting.

Shin-chan has an upset stomach as he's not gone to the toilet for 3 days. The teachers give him medicine and he gets well.

Shin-chan goes to a restaurant with Hiroshi as Misae is not home, but Hiroshi finds it tedious being with Shin-chan and is relieved when Misae returns.

episodes.title: Watching Action Mask / School Lunch Is Fun / Going to the Dentist
episodes.synopsis:
When he fails to reach home by his curfew, Misae punishes Shin by making him sit out on the porch, causing him to miss out on "Action Mask". Shin tries all sorts of ways to get into the house, until he discovers a loophole and goes to watch it at Nene's house instead.

All the food containers fall on the ground because of Shin-chan, so Kazama makes an excuse, but later realizes there is more food.

Misae takes Shin-chan to the dentist to get his cavities treated. After coming home, he continues eating junk food, which annoys her.

episodes.title: Chivalry Sunflower Group / Going on a Picnic (Part 1) / Going on a Picnic (Part 2)
episodes.synopsis:
The principal visits the students. Shin-chan asks the principal to sing a song. He kicks an empty can on a car, but the principal saves him.

Shin-chan helps Misae prepare food for the picnic. Shin-chan keeps some snacks with him and the lunch box on the boot of the car. After Shin-chan and his parents reach the picnic spot, Misae finds out that the lunch box was kept on the boot of the car.

episodes.title: Watching a Movie / A Good Child`s Present / Helping Out
episodes.synopsis:
Misae and Shin-chan go for a movie in a theatre, but Shin-chan disturbs her and everyone watching the film. As a result, she is forced to leave.

Yoshinaga asks Shin-chan to be good by keeping the surrounding clean, as a birthday gift. Everyone get amazed with Shin-chan's behaviour.

Shin-chan wakes his father for food and acts stubborn with him. He drops the entire juice on the ground.

episodes.title: Doin` Justice! / Feeding a Tadpole / Mommy and the Bathroom Sorting
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan helps Misae in the house work, but draws pictures on the walls and on his and Misae's face with the permanent marker when Misae falls asleep. Hiroshi fails to control his laughter.

Shin-chan and other students learn about tadpoles in school. Masao and Kazama bring tadpoles school. Yoshinaga puts the tadpoles into the pond after knowing about their life when they grow up.

Shin takes a bath with Misae because Hiroshi had to work late. In the process, Misae has to refill the bath tub multiple times because Shin kept putting things in (ex. a beer Hiroshi most likely left for his bath, mud or dirt). In the end, Shin pees in the tub and Misae forces Shin to take a shower, in the process Shin knocks down Misae's new expensive "SAKIO" shampoo and it spills in the drain; Shin then turns the water on.

episodes.title: Praticing Blaming Is Hard / Findin` a Puppy / My Name`s Shiro
episodes.synopsis:
Yoshinaga trains the students about the evacuation process. Shin-chan uses the extinguisher and blows off the fire. Everyone feel proud of him.

Shin-chan finds an unknown puppy and takes him home. He hides it from his mother, but she realizes and scolds him. Misae doesn't let the puppy stay in the house but as Shin-chan gets attached to it, they keep it and name it Shiro.

episodes.title: Walkin` with Shiro / Buildin` Shiro`s House / I Hate Piiman!
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan plays with Shiro and takes him for a walk. Shiro eats all the meat that was kept for dinner, leaving Misae and Shin-chan with nothing to eat.

Hiroshi creates a dog house for Shiro but Misae spoils it, so they buy a readymade dog house.

Shin-chan gets engrossed in the TV that he hardly eats his food. Misae forces Shin-chan to eat capsicum but he refuses and gives it to Shiro.

episodes.title: Don`t Intrude, Daddy! / Playin` with Clay / Readin` at the Bookstore
episodes.synopsis:
Misae manages to stop Shin-chan from disturbing Hiroshi. After finishing his work, Hiroshi plays with Shin-chan, but unknowingly, Shin-chan ruins Hiroshi's work.

Yoshinaga teaches the children to create stuff with clay. Shin-chan borrows clay from Yoshinaga and creates a giraffe.

Shin-chan goes to a book shop and reads comic books but doesn't take any. He finally leaves with his mother.

episodes.title: College Girls Are My Friends / I Want a High-Grade Swimming-Suit / Time for the Pool
episodes.synopsis: Shin-chan wears his swim suit and goes to school. Yoshinaga teaches the children how to swim. Shin-chan floats in the water like Shiro. Kazama challenges Shin-chan in a swimming competition but loses it. He feels ashamed of himself and decides to take training from Shiro. The principal promotes Yoshinaga on basis her work. Shin-chan reaches home and falls asleep.

episodes.title: Feeding Shiro / Fightin` Couples Are Troublesome / A Parent-and-Child Dragnet
episodes.synopsis:
Misae gets dog food from the market for Shiro. But Shin-chan forgets feeding Shiro and due to hunger, he eats Misae's dress.

Misae scolds Shin-chan for watching TV and not doing his homework, but Hiroshi pampers Shin-chan. Hence, Misae gets angry on him.

The students and their parents go on a family picnic organized by the school. They involve themselves in fishing and have a great time.

episodes.title: Goin` to the Barber`s / Protectin` My Treasure / Filmin` a Video
episodes.synopsis:
Hiroshi and Shin-chan go to the salon for a haircut. The hair stylist leaves the job because of Shin-chan's mischief. Hiroshi and Shin-chan get kicked out.

All the students talk about the treasures they have. Shin-chan appoints himself as Masao's bodyguard and protects him wherever he goes.

Hiroshi and Misae purchase a camera. Hiroshi creates a realistic video of Misae and Shin-chan together.

episodes.title: Sea Water Bath`s Are Fun / Staying at a Luxurious Hotel / The Road Home Is Long
episodes.synopsis: Hiroshi, Misae and Shin-chan go to Sea Side Hotel for a holiday. Shin-chan acts stubborn and eats a lot of ice cream using the key of the room and catches cold. Hiroshi, Misae and Shin-chan leave from Sea Side Hotel to go home and get stuck in traffic. After being stranded for so long and reaching home at 3am, Misae and Hiroshi get very tired but Shin-chan stays fresh.

episodes.title: Mom`s Nap / Havin` an Ego / This Time, We`re Doin` Fireworks
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan plays with Shiro so that his mother can get some sleep. When Misae wakes up, she finds Shin-chan fast to sleep in Shiro's house.

Shin-chan goes for English tutions. The teacher gets annoyed with Shin-chan and sends him home with the frog puppet.

Shin-chan goes shopping with his mom and purchases crackers. He burns the sparklers on the gas stove but Hiroshi quickly blows it off.

episodes.title: Ridin` the Train / Rode the Train / Chosin` a Bath
episodes.synopsis: Shin-chan and his mother go to the station. While waiting for the train to arrive, Shin-chan forces his mother to take him to the washroom but doesn't go. Finally, they go home in a taxi. Misae and Shin-chan board the train to go to the departmental store but forget their shoes in the train. They get late to reach the store.

episodes.title: Mom`s Nursin` / Playin` with a Bully / Goin` to a Temple Festival
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan helps his mother get well by filling the ice bag with water but forgets to close it because of which, the rooms gets flooded.

Shin-chan and Masao go into the park to play. Shin-chan bravely chases away Takeshi who snatches food from other children.

Shin-chan spends his parent's money on food and games at a fair. They end their day by watching fireworks.

episodes.title: Let`s Get Slothed / Lets Act Crazy / Closet Stakeout
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan and his parents watch Action Mask live. Shin-chan feels glad on meeting Action Mask and getting an autograph from him.

Yoshinaga reaches the venue quite early to meet a client. Till then, Shin-chan comes and annoys her. Hiroshi invites her for tea and snacks. Misae prepares variety of cuisines, as Shin-chan fulfils his responsibility of giving bath to Shiro.

episodes.title: Break Yo Mamma`s Back / Hellion Crawler Baby / Guess Who`s Slumming to Dinner
episodes.synopsis:
Hiroshi decides to train Shin-chan to be a baseball player. He begins his training but takes Shiro along with him instead of Shin-chan.

Shin-chan meets Nene-chan's mother and frustrates her. Nene-chan cries on seeing her mother yell, but Shin-chan doesn't bother. On Shin-chan's grandparent's arrival, Misae prepares a variety of cuisine. Shin-chan enjoys the company of his grandfather.

episodes.title: The House Is Official Unblown / Can`t Elope / Whiteface Charcoalpants
episodes.synopsis:
Misae and Shin-chan stay in door due to a bad weather. Hiroshi returns from work and stays out, as they all fall asleep.

The senior students ask Shin-chan to come after school with his team to play, but Shin-chan acts lazy. The senior students cry over it.

Shin-chan writes a letter to Misae which states that Shin-chan loves his mother a lot. Misae gets emotional on reading it.

episodes.title: Bed Bath and Poo-ed On / Planet of the Dogs / Planet of the Dogs 2 Holy Shihtzu!....
episodes.synopsis:
After finishing his lunch, Shin-chan brushes his teeth with new toothpaste. His mother beats him for eating junk food after brushing and makes him brush his teeth again.

Yoshinaga trains the students to dance for the sports day. As Matsuzaka and Yoshinaga go to meet the principal, Kazama takes lead, but Shin-chan does his own steps.

episodes.title: Do Your Best at the Sports Festival / Run with Your Mother / The Relay`s a Competition
episodes.synopsis: On the sports day, Shin-chan begins marching well, but forgets his steps. All the students get confused and follow Shin-chan. During the sports day, the children take a break before the parent-child race. Misae and Shin-chan begin their race but Shin-chan ruins it. In an interclass relay race, Shin-chan races Kawamura and wins it. The Sunflower group praises Shin-chan for that.

episodes.title: Grapple with Mum / Play with Soap / It`s the Bookstore Owner Again
episodes.synopsis:
Misae doesn't let Shin-chan in, but he enters anyhow and watches Action Mask. Later, he hides in the washroom to escape Misae's scolding.

Shin-chan challenges Kazama to make a big bubble out of the soap water that his mother made for him and wins it.

Shin-chan buys 2 magazines and forgets the change at the counter. The cashier runs after him to return it but Shin-chan fails to understand.

episodes.title: The Password Is Misae / Competition on Stilts / Going to Greet Father
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan decides a code for him and his mother as she goes out. Shin-chan makes the courier man utter the code and pesters him.

Yoshinaga brings stilts for the kids to play. Kawamura and Kazama give up, but Shin-chan continues performing stunts on the stilts.

Shin-chan and Misae go to the station to pick Hiroshi as he doesn't have an umbrella. They decide to get drenched and enjoy the showers.

episodes.title: Part-time Jobs for College Girls Are Tough / I`m in a Play / Settling a Couple`s Quarrel
episodes.synopsis: Shin-chan gives a hand-written note to purchase a burger. The manager yells at the girl and makes her pay for it. Shin-chan brings his friends along to eat burgers with the hand-written notes. Shin-chan plays the role of a good man in an act at school by helping a bird and gets a gift in return. He gets confused with the gifts and says what he is not supposed to, but the audience enjoy the act.

episodes.title: Battle with a Cockroach / Time for a Physical Exam / Washing the Car with Dad
episodes.synopsis:
Misae seeks help from Shin-chan to look out for a cockroach and chase it away. After a long struggle, they fail to get hold of the cockroach.

Shin-chan helps Hiroshi in washing the car and scrapes the paint. After they finish with the wash, Misae ends up putting a scratch on the car with her bicycle.

episodes.title: Lost at the Department Store / Cleaning the Chicken Coop / My Shichi-Go-San
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan joins his mother at the departmental store and realises that he is lost at the store. He seeks help from the staff.

Shin-chan and his friends clean the poultry farm. Shin-chan reaches home and sits on the eggs to get chicks out of it.

Shin-chan visits the temple with his parents and prays that Misae gives him choco chips instead of capsicum.

episodes.title: Gargling Prevents Colds / Helping Yoshinaga-sensei / Buying Baked Sweet Potatoes
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan falls sick. So, his mother gets him some medicines and teaches him how to gargle his mouth but he acts mischievous.

Shin-chan and Nene-chan meet Yoshinaga. Shin-chan troubles her by taking her belongings and later asks for forgiveness from her.

Shin-chan purchases sweet potatoes for his mother from a vendor and decides to purchase it every time.

episodes.title: Visiting Someone at the Hospital / Playing Hide and Seek / Going to the Zoo
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan goes to the hospital with Misae and troubles the nurse. He gets scolded by his mother. Misae feels sorry for not recognizing Mrs Kiko. When Shin-chan plays the hide-and-seek game with his friends, he hides and falls asleep. Later, his friends and Misae go in search of him.

Shin-chan gets interviewed when he goes to the zoo with his family. He feels excited to see himself on the TV.

episodes.title: The Zoo Is So Much Fun / At the Beauty Salon with Mom / I Want a New Year`s Gift
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan goes out for a school trip to the zoo and troubles the animals and his teacher at the zoo.

Shin-chan goes to the beauty parlour with his mother and troubles her and the babysitter to play Action games with him.

Shin-chan's goes shopping with his parents and demands gifts from them.

episodes.title: At the Bank with Mom / Me and the Policewomen / Taking a Bath with Dad
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan follows Misae on her way to the bank to withdraw money and harasses her by not letting her withdraw cash.

The traffic cops visit Shin-chan's school to teach the students about traffic safety rules. They complain to the teacher about Shin-chan being the naughtiest child in the class.

??

episodes.title: Watching Over the House with Shiro / Matsuzaka-sensei`s Secret / Grandpa`s Here Again
episodes.synopsis: Misae asks Shin-chan to be at home with Shiro and take care of the house so that she can go out to buy groceries. After Misae returns from the market, she gets furious on seeing the mess in the house. Shin-chan keeps a watch on his school teacher and later tells everyone about Matsuzaka eating free food at the market and gets her embarrassed.

episodes.title: My First Time Skiing / Kazama-kun`s Place Is Fun / X`mas with Action Mask
episodes.synopsis: Shin-chan and Hiroshi experience a snow storm while skiing, so they return home. Shin-chan visits Kazama's house and gets amazed to see such a beautiful house. Later, he acts mischievous and ends up messing the entire house. Shin-chan meets Action Mask on Christmas day but later, gets to know the fact that it is Hiroshi dressed up as Action Mask and feels sad.

episodes.title: Eating Ozouni / Having Fun Flying Kites / Making a Snowman
episodes.synopsis:
Misae prepares mushroom soup but while having it, Shin-chan begins to play with the food and ends up troubling his mother.

Shin-chan and his friends fly kites, but as the strings entangle, they take Hiroshi's help to sort it out.

Shin-chan goes out with his father and makes a huge snowman. Later, Shin-chan dresses the snowman with Misae's clothes.

episodes.title: Making Bentos Is Tough / Playing House / Helping Out at the Bookstore
episodes.synopsis: Shin is helping Misae cook for dinner while making things *way* more complicated. Using the skill Misae just showed him, Shin 'play cooks'.

episodes.title: I`m a Photo Model / A Fun Trip to the Hot Springs / A Mixed Bath at the Hot Springs
episodes.synopsis: Shin-chan gets the opportunity to become a model for a magazine's ad. After the shoot, Kiko's camera breaks because of Shin-chan's mistake. A person comes to learn swimming from Shin-chan and his parents are worried and run to save Shin-chan and get to know the unknown person was a good man.

episodes.title: Throwing Beans for Setsubun / Misae Gets Roped In / Hot Pot Is the Best in Winter
episodes.synopsis:
The students and Yoshinaga throw beans out in the air as a celebration to bring peace and harmony.

Shin-chan and Misae go shopping. A sales executive tries hard to make a sale, but Shin-chan troubles Misae and they leave.

Shin-chan, Misae and Hiroshi prepare a hot pot meal together. They have dinner and fun at the same time.

episodes.title: I Caught a Cold / Being a Police Officer Is Tough / Singing Karaoke
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan visits the doctor with his mother to treat his fever and troubles him. The doctor regrets being a child specialist.

Shin-chan gets lost and meets a policeman. He troubles the policeman with his questions. Misae finds Shin-chan in the police station and gets happy.

Hiroshi, Misae, Shin-chan and Kiko go out for a Karaoke box event. They all sing at the event and have a great time.

episodes.title: Going to Buy Taiyaki / The Kindergarten Sleepover / Nighttime at the Kindergarten Sleepover
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan goes to buy groceries for his mother but pesters the shopkeeper with his questions.

The students celebrate 'child care day' in school. Yoshinaga plays a documentary for them. In the night, on listening to a horror story, Shin-chan gets restless and wakes Kazama to play with him. Shin-chan falls asleep in the toilet when he goes with Masao.

episodes.title: Quiet in the Library / Practicing for the Marathon / The School Marathon
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan and Misae visit a library to purchase books for Shin-chan, but he troubles his mother and the librarian by making sounds.

Shin-chan, Hiroshi and Misae go out to practise for the marathon, but they find it difficult due to the cold weather.

The Rose group and the Sunflower group get into a marathon race. The principal declares Shin-chan as the winner as he helps Masao in his injury.

episodes.title: It`s Hinamatsuri / Going to a Swimming School / Teaching Shiro Tricks
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan and his friends go to Nene-chan's house. Nene-chan's mother prepares cake for the kids but Shin-chan ruins it.

Misae sends Shin-chan to the swimming school to learn swimming and feels happy to see Shin-chan swim by himself.

Shin-chan trains Shiro to be a circus star but Shiro flops at the time of the presentation. Shin-chan gets upset but he tries again.

episodes.title: Playing Badminton / Going on a Field Trip / Going for a Walk with the Great Shiro
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan plays badminton with Hiroshi and Misae. But during the game, Misae and Hiroshi end up fighting with each other.

The students go on a study tour to the bread factory. Shin-chan ends up troubling Yoshinaga during their journey.

Shin-chan troubles Misae by messing up the house. Later, when Shiro and Shin-chan go for a walk, they meet Kawamura and compare his dog with Shiro.

episodes.title: Getting Pizza Delivered / Masao-kun`s Got a Hamster / Airing Out Our Futons
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan drops the pizza that Misae orders and does not tell her about it. She relishes the pizza and realises later that it was the same pizza.

Masao brings a rat to school. Shin-chan frightens Yoshinaga with it, so she takes help from Matsuzaka and gets rid of it.

Shin-chan gets a nightmare of a monster and wets his bed. Next morning, Shin-chan is made to dry his mattress.

episodes.title: Soccer Practice / The Soccer Tournament / There`s an Earthquake
episodes.synopsis:
While playing soccer, Kawamura underestimates Shin-chan and his friends but fails to score a goal. He cries and leaves the ground.

Both the groups compete in a soccer match. The Sunflower team wins the match by scoring at the penalty shootouts.

Misae, Shin-chan and Hiroshi prepare themselves for the earthquake. But fall asleep when it actually takes place.

episodes.title: Finding a Spot for a Cherry Blossom Party / Cherry Blossom Parties Are Fun / Going to Dad`s Office
episodes.synopsis:
A man blocks a place for him to sleep and does not let the children in that area. Later, the children take over. So he convinces the kids by giving them ice cream to get his place back.

Misae and Shin-chan go to Hiroshi's office to deliver some papers. On reaching the office, Shin-chan and Misae are being greeted by Hiroshi's colleagues. Shin-chan feels happy to see his dad work so hard.

episodes.title: Planting Flowers / Running to the General Store / The Missing Eyebrow Look
episodes.synopsis:
Yoshinaga teaches the students how to sow seeds. Shin-chan gets the water pipe and waters the seeds that are sown.

Misae sends Shin-chan with a list of grocery items but loses it. He returns home with vegetables of his choice and gets scolding from his mother.

Shin-chan observes his dad shaving and shaves off his one eyebrow. He goes out to escape from his mother's scolding.

episodes.title: Dad`s Drunk / I`m a Detective / Going Shopping with Mom
episodes.synopsis: Shin-chan decides to help Maso to search his Crayon. After a long investigation, Shin-chan remembers Maso lending him the Crayon and he returns it back to Maso. Shin-chan is excited to go shopping with his mother. Later, he is confused[clarification needed] to pick snacks for himself and ends up picking and expensive snack for himself.

episodes.title: Putting Up Carp Streamers / Playing Kick the Can / Hanging with the Elevator Girl
episodes.synopsis:
Hiroshi purchases carp streamer for his son and gives Shin-chan a surprise.

Shin-chan borrows a can from his principle to play kick can with his friends. They get Yoshinaga out of the game. She gets furious.

Shin-chan gets stuck in the elevator when he goes shopping with his parents. After a long wait, they finally get their son back.

episodes.title: Mom Sprained Her Back / The Saleslady from Hell / Today Is Mother`s Day
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan goes along with his mother to the doctor as she has a backache, but troubles the doctor there.

Shin-chan meets an aunt while playing whom he has seen before on TV. Shin-chan troubles the sales woman and gets her arrested by the police.

Shin-chan makes a mother's day card for his mother and also helps her in making a cake. Hiroshi gets amazed to see Shin-chan taking care of Misae.

episodes.title: Heading Off on a Field Trip / Disaster on a Field Trip / Playing with Fire Is Scary
episodes.synopsis: Shin-chan troubles Yoshinaga during a school trip. Later, when Kazama and Shin-chan go to the washroom, Shin-chan drops Kazama's handkerchief and makes him cry. During the trip, Shin-chan and his friends walk towards the jungle and lose their way. They meet Yoshinaga and feel safe.

episodes.title: I`m Not Good at Cleaning Up / Nighttime Is for Adults / My Book`s a Bestseller
episodes.synopsis:
Misae decides to throw Shin-chan's toys out of the house. So, Shin-chan takes his toys and hides it at Shinobu's place.

Shin-chan wakes up from his sleep and finds his parents having chocolate chips without him. Misae tries to put Shin-chan to sleep but he doesn't asleep again.

Shin-chan visits the bookstore to sell his book and takes the money from the customer who purchases his book.

episodes.title: Helping Out with the Weeding / Yoshinaga-sensei`s Suddenly Sick / Visiting Yoshinaga-sensei at the Hospital
episodes.synopsis: While Shin-chan waits for his mother to come to pick him up, Yoshinaga falls ill. Shin-Chan seeks help from Matsuzaka. The Principal takes few students to meet Yoshinaga at the hospital. After they reach the hospital, they greet her and give her best wishes to get well soon.

episodes.title: Even Throwing Away Trash Is Tough / The Saleslady from Hell Returns / Eating Conveyor Belt Sushi
episodes.synopsis:
While searching for a garbage van, Shin-chan tears the garbage bag and messes up the entire place.

The sales executive follows Shin-chan to force him to buy the book but Shin-chan manages to escape from there.

Hiroshi takes his family out for lunch. Shin-chan messes the entire place and gets his parents embarrassed.

episodes.title: Helping Those in Need / Building Stuff Is Tough / Shiro`s Missing
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan decides to help people. He meets a man who asks him the way to Kazama's house. But Shin-chan pesters him.

Matsuzaka and Yoshinaga build a wooden house for the kids to play. But Shin-chan kicks the football and knocks down the new house.

Shiro leaves the house as Shin-chan troubles him. Shin-chan gets very worried about Shiro. However, Shiro returns home in the night.

episodes.title: Questioning a Politician / Obeying My Dear Sister / Today Is Father`s Day
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan meets a politician at an old age home and leads him into trouble before the media by asking him questions.

Fumie visits Shin-chan to take care of him in Misae's absence. Fumie lies to Shin-chan that she is his sister and makes him behave as per her.

Misae and Shin-chan forget that it is Father's day and make Hiroshi do their work. But later, they get gifts for him and make him happy.

episodes.title: Making a Manly Meal / Mom`s Got a Toothache / Looking for a Wedding Dress
episodes.synopsis:
Hiroshi and Shin-chan prepare food together. Shin-chan adds some orange juice in the food for fun, which enhances the flavor of the meal.

Misae suffers from a toothache and hides it from Shin-chan. On knowing about it, Shin-chan takes Misae to the dentist.

Keiko, Shin-chan, and Misae visit a store to purchase a wedding gown. Keiko meets her neighbor and invites him to her wedding party.

episodes.title: Playing with the Bully Again / Attending a Wedding / The Wedding Party
episodes.synopsis:
Takeshi asks Shin-chan and Suzuki to take him to Masao's house. But, Shin-chan takes him to his house where Takeshi's mother scolds Takeshi.

Hiroshi and his family reach for the nuptial before the bride and the groom.

episodes.title: Too Scared to Sleep / Having Fun Cleaning the Pool / We Won a Trip to Guam
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan watches a horror show before going to bed and gets petrified in the night. At the end, Shin-chan sleeps with Hiroshi.

The principal, Matsuzaka, and Yoshinaga decide to clean the swimming pool. Shin-chan also joins them in cleaning.

Misae, Hiroshi, and Shin-chan win a long trip as a gift for the quiz played. The family practice speaking in English as they will be traveling by plane.

episodes.title: Blowing Up Balloons / I Found a Wallet / Sightseeing in Tokyo with Grandpa
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan insists his mother blow balloons for him and doesn't let her relax. So, Misae blows all the balloons and plays with Shin-chan.

Shin-chan and Nene-chan find a purse fallen on the ground. Shin-chan gets a reward for returning his mother's purse to her.

Shin-chan's grandparents take Shin-chan for a sightseeing in Tokyo. They all enjoy themselves and return home in the evening.

episodes.title: Eating Shaved Ice / Shiro Gets a Shot / Going Camping with the Family
episodes.synopsis:
As it is hot, Shin-chan forces Misae to buy ice crushers. He eats a lot of ice candies and upsets his stomach.

Shin-chan and Kawamura take their dogs for a vaccination. Shiro, courageously, steps forward and gets himself injected.

Shin-chan and his family go camping. They set a tent and cook food. They stay awake in the night as it rains. And in the morning, they all fall asleep.

episodes.title: I`m Gonna Be a Famous Singer Someday / The Railroad Goes On / One Extremely Hot, Sweltering Night
episodes.synopsis:
Misae takes Shin-chan to a music school to train him, but she gets angry on the teacher and returns home.

Shin-chan and his friends decide to play the engine game and draw tracks on the road. Kazama returns home while the rest enjoy the game.

As it is very hot, the family convince themselves and sleep under one fan. But in the night, the fan stops working and a mosquito disturbs them.

episodes.title: Yoshinaga-sensei`s Private Life / The Saleslady`s Last Shot / Buying an Air Conditioner
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan stays at Yoshinaga's house checks her room to find something different but Yoshinaga stops him.

A sales girl, Urima follows Shin-chan to sell a set of books and CDs to Misae. She loses a track of Shin-chan and gives up.

Misae, Hiroshi, and Shin-chan decide to buy an A/C. But Misae gets to know that the price of the A/C will reduce after a year. So, she drops the idea of buying it.

episodes.title: Going to the Gas Station / Watermelons Abound / Playing Split-the-Watermelon
episodes.synopsis:
Hiroshi and Shin-chan go to a petrol pump to fill fuel. Shin-chan troubles the attendant and gets her sacked out from her job.

While Shin-chan's grandfather sends watermelons for Shin-chan, Misae and Hiroshi also bring watermelons home. They all have watermelon for dinner.

The family plays 'break the watermelon game'. Shin-chan succeeds in breaking the watermelon and wins the game.

episodes.title: Matsuzaka-sensei`s Got a Date / Sumo Practice / Trying My Best at the Sumo Tournament
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan interrupts Matsuzaka and her boyfriend's meeting. So, Matsuzaka takes Shin-chan along with her and returns home.

Hiroshi trains Shin-chan for a sumo wrestling match held for the kids. Shin-chan drops the washed clothes rack on the ground, for which Hiroshi gets a beating.

Shin-chan gets into a competition with a strong trained child wrestler, Tarau and wins the match.

episodes.title: Going to the Police Station / Going Bug Catching / Cleaning with Mom
episodes.synopsis:
Hiroshi and Shin-chan go to the police station to renew Hiroshi's driving license. Shin-chan annoys the lady officer in charge with his mischief.

Shin-chan, Masao, and Bo-chan go on a trek to find insects. Shin-chan kicks a tree and fortunately, finds an insect.

Hiroshi complains about the mess in the house. So, the next day, Misae and Shin-chan clean the house and surprise Hiroshi.

episodes.title: Flooding During a Typhoon / Showdown with the Girl Gang / It`s a Dodgeball Battle
episodes.synopsis:
Due to heavy rains, Misae shifts the things from the ground floor to the first floor. But she forgets to close the tap, which results in a flood.

Shin-chan plays with the girls from the Saitama group. The rivals of the Saitama group find the girls immature and return.

Shin-chan and his friends have a dodgeball competition with the senior students. Shin-chan and his friends win the match.

episodes.title: I`m a Detective / Heading to the Hospital in an Ambulance / I`m Popular Even at the Hospital
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan and his friends play the detective game and help Yoshinaga find her lost sandal that was stolen by a dog.

Shin-chan eats a lot of snacks in the night and complains about pain in his stomach. So, Hiroshi and Misae take him to the hospital in an ambulance and admit him.

The other patients give Shin-chan sweets as a gift on his farewell. Shin-chan eats the sweets and falls sick again.

episodes.title: The Newlywed Comes Over / Training for the Race / Capturing Sports Day on Video
episodes.synopsis:
Keiko meets Shin-chan in Misae's absence and spends time with Shin-chan while waiting for Misae.

On a Sunday, Hiroshi and Misae train Shin-chan for a race. But Shin-chan does not pay attention.

During Shin-chan's sports event, Hiroshi shoots a video of Shin-chan to show Shin-chan's grandparents. But Misae captures Action Mask video in the cassette and puts Hiroshi's effort in vain.

episodes.title: Mom`s on a Diet / Tackling an Obstacle Course / Dad`s Missing Eyebrows
episodes.synopsis:
Misae tries hard to lose weight and plans a diet. But she fails to resist her food craving and eats stomach full.

The school organizes an athletic training for its students. At the end, all the students get a pack of snacks as a reward for completing the given task.

While Hiroshi sleeps, Shin-chan trims Hiroshi's eyebrows. Later, Misae and Shin-chan come up with ideas to rectify the problem.

episodes.title: Carrying a Mikoshi / Prepping for a Flea Market / Selling Stuff at a Flea Market
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan and his group create a box house and decorate it with flowers, animal pictures, and Shin-chan's action robot for a competition.

Misae, Shin-chan, and Hiroshi segregate the unwanted things present in the house that can be sold in a flea market and find Shin-chan's baby toys.

Misae, Keiko, and Shin-chan put up a stall to sell their things. Shin-chan barters his old toys for better ones.

episodes.title: Fixing the Gutter / I Love Expensive Sushi / My Little Brother, the Chickee
episodes.synopsis:
Hiroshi climbs the roof to repair the broken pipe. He loses his balance because of Shin-chan's mischief and hangs on the pipe.

Shin-chan goes to Nene-chan's house for lunch and finishes 50 percent of the food alone. Moeko consoles herself by singing and dancing.

Shin-chan finds a left out chick and takes it home. He goes to return the chick back, but the vendor gifts it to him.

episodes.title: Searching for the Chickens / Helping Out with the Laundry / Visiting the Newlyweds
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan takes his chick to school and leaves it in the poultry farm. The chicks and the hen go out from the farm and return on their own.

Misae dries the clothes in the house, as it rains. Later, when it gets sunny, she washes all the dirty clothes with Shin-chan's help.

Keiko invites Misae and her family to her new house. Shin-chan finds a room with toys and has fun playing with Satoshi.

episodes.title: Playing School / Having a Barbecue / Dad`s Worn Out
episodes.synopsis:
As Misae goes out, Fumie takes care of Shin-chan and teaches him maths while playing the school game.

Shin-chan eats Masao's steak and troubles him while preparing barbecue. So, he gives Masao his share of corn and also entertains him.

Hiroshi returns home tired and worried about his work and decides to quit his job. But on seeing Shin-chan, he realizes that he should continue with his job.

episodes.title: Mom`s in Her School Uniform / Having Fun in a Model House / Taking a Family Photo
episodes.synopsis:
Misae finds her school uniform and wears it. The principal notices Misae and embarrasses her.

Sumitakunaru sets her house with the latest technology in the hope of getting a good customer. But Shin-chan and the other kids chase the customer away.

Misae and Hiroshi visit the photo studio to click a family picture.But, Shin-chan ruins the pictures with his mischievous poses.

episodes.title: Doing Some Sewing / I Hate Shots / A Visitor Comes Over
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan learns the art of stitching. And when Misae falls asleep, Shin-chan stitches the clothes from the house.

At school, the doctor diverts children's attention so as to vaccinate them. But Shin-chan builds a conversation with the doctor to avoid the injection.

Misae prepares food for Kawaguchi on his sudden visit. And after having food, Kawaguchi and Shin-chan play together and have fun.

episodes.title: Too Much Praise Is Torture / Dad Really Hates Cats / Another Fun Day at the Bookstore
episodes.synopsis:
Misae appreciates Shin-chan mistakes instead of correcting him so that he changes his behavior.

A cat hurts Hiroshi several time and disturbs him while working. In the night, Hiroshi envies the cat's life as he finds it difficult to complete his work.

The bookstore owner and Nagamura prepare to welcome the bookstore inspection officer. But a confusion leads them in not getting their bonus.

episodes.title: Eating Ramen / I`m an Ice Skating Natural / The Newlyweds Have a Fight
episodes.synopsis:
When Misae and Shin-chan go to a restaurant to eat noodles, Shin-chan drops the bowl of noodles on the table while pouring it in his bowl.

Hiroshi, Misae, and Shin-chan go for ice skating o get some winter exercise. Shin-chan skates with great ease and impresses an ice skating champion.

Keiko runs away to the home of her friend Misae for comfort and advice because Satoshi scolds her for a cooking silly quarrel. Later, Satoshi apologizes to Keiko and takes her home back.

episodes.title: Making Cookies / Matsuzaka-sensei`s Blind Date / Elections Are a Nightmare
episodes.synopsis:
Misae has long dreamed of being a mother who bakes cookies with her child, but things don't go smoothly when Shin-chan is involved. Shin-chan prepares cookies shaped with Misae, Hiroshi and his face.

Shin-chan and his family visit the same fancy restaurant that Matsuzaka and her date visits. Matsuzaka tries hard to hide from Shin-chan. But her behavior annoys her date.

A politician is giving a speech on the street, asking passersby for their support in the upcoming election, when Shin-chan interrupts him.

episodes.title: Knitting a Sweater / Riding a Packed Train / Playing at Dad`s Office
episodes.synopsis:
Misae unknits Hiroshi's old sweater to make a new one for him but ends up knitting a sweater for Shiro with the same wool.

Hiroshi is on his way to work when he encounters Shin-chan, who is playing detective and has trailed him to the train station. Shin-chan pesters the passengers in the train with his mischief and his talks.

Hiroshi brings Shin-chan to his office. Arriving at the office, Hiroshi tells Shin-chan to wait patiently in the lobby till his mother can come and get him. Shin-chan escapes from the recreational room and meets the president of the company and has fun with him.

episodes.title: Episode 79
episodes.synopsis:
Kei invites Misae and Shin-chan to a fashion show, where Shin-chan is chosen by a fashion designer as a last-minute substitute for a child model who is ill. Shin-chan gets nervous and ruins the fashion show.

As the year comes to an end, Shin-chan’s class is supposed to clean the school today, but Shin-chan has his own unique approach.

Shin-chan has a conversation with his friends in the park about the New Year's eve bell. He stays awake till 12 am to hear the bell and then falls asleep.

episodes.title: Episode 80
episodes.synopsis:
Misae gives Shin-chan a ball instead of a coin on New Year's day. Later, as Misae breaks the ball, she gives him a real coin.

Shin-chan goes shopping but doesn't spend his New Year coin. He saves the coin and admires it even in his sleep.

Shin-chan’s grandparents arrive for a visit without warning determined to enjoy their grandson, even if it makes Misae’s life more difficult. Shin-chan and his grandfather agree to help Misae in cleaning but add to the mess.

episodes.title: Episode 81
episodes.synopsis:
The school takes the students and their families for skiing. Matsuzaka doesn't know how to ski but she tries her best.

The principal sends everyone back to the hotel to get some rest. Shin-chan and his friends see Matsuzaka performing in a nightclub and join her.

The Nohara family is at a ski resort, but Shin-chan causes problems that interfere with his parents’ attempts to ski.

episodes.title: Episode 82
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan often oversleeps and misses the school bus. Misae resents having to take him to kindergarten on her bicycle, so she devises a plan and wakes him up. But she receives a call from Yoshinaga telling her that the bus has broken down.

Masao has a crush on Megumi, a girl from the other kindergarten class, but he’s too shy to speak to her.

Shin-chan is hungry after playing outside, but Misae is entertaining guests and can’t make anything for him. Shin-chan finds it difficult to control his hunger and prepares a meal for himself.

episodes.title: Episode 83
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan goes to the girls school where the Saitama group girls study without informing Misae. So, he gets scolding from her.

Shin-chan and Shiro enter a random house and spends their day there. Later, Misae tells Shin-chan about the new show Pencil Shin-chan.

Misae tries to keep Shin-chan away from the craze of the Pencil Shin-chan program but Shin-chan gets busy watching Action Mask.

episodes.title: I Won The Lottery! / Let`s Go to a Funeral! / A Snowball Fight Challenge
episodes.synopsis:
After reading a magazine horoscope, Misae decides to buy a lottery ticket. Misae, Hiroshi and Shin-chan each dream of what they would do if they won. But Shin-chan receives a jumbo Chocobi packet along with a t-shirt, whereas Misae and Hiroshi do not win anything.

The Nohara family has to attend a funeral, and Shin-chan is warned to behave himself. However, he is not quite sure what behavior is required as Shin-chan disturbs everyone by playing the instruments.

The two kindergarten classes start a snowball fight, which brings out the personal animosity between Ms. Yoshinaga and Ms. Matsuzaka.

episodes.title: I`m changing my hairstyle! / Visiting Kazama-kun at his illness! / The chairman`s house is a villa!
episodes.synopsis:
Misae decides to cut Shin-chan’s hair. She sets up a chair in his room and tells him that they are going to play barbershop. While cutting Shin-chan's hair, Misae shaves a portion of his head bald. So, Misae draws a black spot with the marker to cover it.

Shin-chan and Nene go to visit Kazama, who is home sick with a cold. However, Kazama is irritated by Shin-chan’s presence. Shin-chan troubles Kazama and makes him run. As a result, Kazama's body temperature drops down and he feels good.

Hiroshi’s boss has just built a new house and holds a housewarming party. The Nohara family attends, but Shin-chan can’t help disrupting the event.

episodes.title: Hatena is a mysterious cat! / Cleaning your ears feels good! / Misae`s Class reunion
episodes.synopsis:
Hatena the cat is stealing Shiro’s food. Bo and Shin-chan follow her, trying to figure out where she lives.

When Hiroshi doesn’t respond to Misae’s voice, it seems that he needs to have wax removed from his ears. Shin-chan wants his ears cleaned, too.

Shin-chan follows Misae to Tokyo for her class reunion, where she get a surprise when she meets her old crush, Mogi.

episodes.title: The Softball Tournament - Part1 / The Softball Tournament - Part2 / Divorce of the Nohara`s!
episodes.synopsis:
The principal of the kindergarten proposes an inter-class softball game, but things start to go wrong during practice when a teacher breaks a window.

Shin-chan begins the baseball match by batting first. And later, he does a good fielding and gets Kawamura out of the game.

A televised debate program prompts a quarrel between Misae and Hiroshi, one that escalates quickly. Can this marriage be saved? What can Shin-chan do? Later, they patch up.

episodes.title: Taking a bath by myself / It`s a tricycle race! / Eating at a `baikingu`
episodes.synopsis:
In preparation for bath time, Misae asks Shin-chan to check the temperature of the water, but Shin-chan has trouble accomplishing this all by himself.

Bullies called the Black Thunders try to chase Shin-chan and his friends out of the park. Their leader, Wolf, challenges Shin-chan to a tricycle race. Although the group leader wins the challenge, Shin-chan rides the cycle like a bike and impresses everyone.

At a posh hotel buffet dinner, the Noharas are ecstatic over the fancy food. Seeing caviar for the first time, Shin-chan makes a unique comment.

episodes.title: Episode 89
episodes.synopsis:
When the Noharas visit an art museum, they voice their opinions on the art loudly and frankly, not realizing that the artist is right next to them. Hence, the artist gets frustrated and leaves the museum.

Shin-chan and friends decide to play “kindergarten,” with Shin-chan playing Kazama’s role, Nene as the teacher Ms. Yoshinaga, and Kazama as Shin-chan.

Hiroshi brings his boss home after work. Unlike the nervous Misae, Shin-chan seems quite relaxed. Will Shin-chan be rude to the boss? Hiroshi and his boss along with Shin-chan have fun together.

episodes.title: Episode 90
episodes.synopsis:
Taking over for Misae who is out buying cold medicine, Shin-chan "takes care of" his sick father, as if Hiroshi isn’t miserable enough already.

Shin-chan and Misae show up at the cosmetics counter where Shinobu works part time. Shinobu’s patience wears thin with Shin-chan’s antics.

Misae feels ill during dinner. Could Shin-chan soon become a big brother? Hiroshi and Misae ponder this. The next day, Misae goes to the hospital. But she gets to know that it was because of overeating.

episodes.title: Episode 91
episodes.synopsis:
The Nohara's win a ticket to Edo Land, a samurai theme park where they can pretend to be feudal lords. Shin-chan enacts a king, Hiroshi a servant and Misae a normal mother.

Shin-chan and his family enact common people of the olden times. Hiroshi and Shin-chan fight the goons and save Misae.

Shin-chan ignores Misae’s warnings and heads to Masao’s house on a very windy day. Shin-chan, caught in a gust of wind, is unable to get anywhere!

episodes.title: Episode 92
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan and his family go for a picnic and spend time with a gangster and his bodyguards.

Yoshinaga goes to change her clothes at Misae's place and forgets about the children in the bus.

Shin-chan watches a noodles advertisement and feels the urge of eating noodles. He takes help from a neighbor and prepares noodles.

episodes.title: Episode 93
episodes.synopsis:
??

??

It's the introduction to the Buri Buri Movie!, an introduction to one of the Crayon Shin-chan movies starring Shinnosuke Nohara and Buriburizaemon.

episodes.title: Episode 94
episodes.synopsis:
The kindergarten class goes shell hunting at the beach. Ms. Yoshinaga’s Sunflower class and Ms. Matsuzaka’s Rose class battle to find the most shells.

On payday, Misae joyfully withdraws their monthly salary from the bank and returns home, only to find that the envelope she put the money in is gone. Hiroshi consoles her but feels very sad from within.

Misae plans her monthly expenses and cuts down on food, electricity, water, and other expenses and promises to be careful with money.

episodes.title: Episode 95
episodes.synopsis:
The kids play a restaurant game in school and make the principal a child. The principal joins them with the intention of learning something new.

Misae decides to learn driving and gets herself enrolled in a motor driving school. She fails the first test.

Misae goes for her driving class along with Shin-chan. Shin-Chan hangs out in a children's room with toy cars. Shin renders these cars as 'lame'. Shin-Chan then drives out of the room and on to the actual course distracting Misae and crashing the car into a sign by the curb. The instructor flunks and refuses to give Misae license because of Shin-chan's mischief.

episodes.title: Episode 96
episodes.synopsis:
Misae hides the fancy cookies she bought for guests where Shin-chan can’t find them, but he soon hunts them down. A battle to grab the cookies begins! Later, they eat the cookies together.

After school, Ms. Matsuzaka runs into Shin-chan, who asks to see her home. She says that it’s a luxury apartment, when in fact it’s old and run-down!

Hiroshi and Misae get into a fight about money. Suddenly, Misae is missing. Could she have run away? Worried, Hiroshi and Shin-chan search for her. But, Misae sleeps in the cabinet.

episodes.title: Episode 97
episodes.synopsis:
Misae takes driving training from Shin-chan as he knows a lot about it. Shin-chan puts traffic signs all over the house as part of the training.

Shin-chan and his friends assume a UFO to be in the sky. But they realize that it's a balloon created to advertise Action Mask.

A very famous writer visits the bookstore. Shin-chan befriends the writer and impresses him.

episodes.title: Episode 98
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan watches Misae cutting a long pant short. And later, after Misae goes out to attend a call, Shin-chan cuts all the clothes short.

Misae and Shin-chan go to a restaurant and share the table with Moeko and Nene-chan. They end up eating the dish ordered by Moeko.

Hiroshi and his family go to a race course to watch a horse race. The horse that Misae bets on, wins the race.

episodes.title: Episode 99
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan misses the kindergarten bus, so Misae has to take him by bike. While waiting at a red light, a beautiful woman pulls up alongside them.

Misae is nervous before her driving test. When she finds out the childcare center is closed, Shin-chan must also come along. Will Misae pass her test? She drives very well keeping the traffic rules in mind. Hence, she passes the test.

Misae gets her driving license and decides to drop Shin-chan to school in the car. However, she reaches the expressway and returns home in the night.

episodes.title: Episode 100
episodes.synopsis:
Shin-chan gets yelled at by Misae for being a bad boy. He opens the fridge and drinks alcohol by mistake, which transforms him into a good boy. Misae and Hiroshi feel happy on seeing Shin-chan's changed behavior.

Hiroshi and his family go bowling. Shin-chan scores a strike. Misae gets angry as Hiroshi and Shin-chan do not watch her play.

Neighbor Mrs. Ujuin keeps her dog at Misae's place and goes to France for a holiday. Shin-chan gives a changes look to the dog by cutting her hair.

info.title: ABCiee Working Diary
info.synopsis: ABCiee è un po' maldestro e stravagante, ma è tanto spocchioso da sognare un lavoro da sogno in una rete televisiva! È una commedia sul lavoro piena di ogni tipo di bravata! episodes.title: It`s Super Busy in the News Biz, Ciee
episodes.synopsis: ABCiee is off to deliver the scripts for today's live broadcast. He then faces the choice of having to use the elevator or the stairs. But that's when he gets a phone call from Crayfish...

episodes.title: Stressful, Ciee! The TV Man Makes a Life-Changing Decision!

episodes.title: The Path of a Cue Card Master Is Rough, Ciee!

episodes.title: Banned Pairings Can Be Complicated, Ciee!

episodes.title: Beware! Comedians Are Sensitive, Ciee!

episodes.title: Please Let Me Through, Ciee! ABko vs. the Security Guard!

episodes.title: Interviewing People in the City Can Be Touching, Ciee!

info.title: High-Rise Invasion

Per questa strana città vagano degli uomini in maschera, armati, pronti a uccidere o a buttare giù dagli edifici chiunque non sia abbastanza veloce da scappare. Con sorpresa, Yuri riesce con il suo cellulare a chiamare il fratello maggiore, il quale l’avverte (prima che cada la linea) di raggiungere la torre più alta della città: lì si sarebbero incontrati e avrebbe avuto delle spiegazioni. Ora Yuri deve solo avanzare e sopravvivere fino alla torre…

episodes.title: I Just Don`t Get This World
episodes.synopsis: Transported to the top of a skyscraper, Yuri desperately tries to evade a masked killer, but her escape routes are few.

episodes.title: I`ve Found a New Goal

episodes.title: I`m Sorry, Mayuko Nise

episodes.title: I Won`t Give in to This World

episodes.title: That`s an Incredible Ultimate Weapon

episodes.title: If I Become a Perfect God

episodes.title: I Will End This Realm

episodes.title: I`ve Cast Off My Humanity, But That`s Fine

episodes.title: Which Of Us Will Live a Cool Live?

episodes.title: Our Enemy Is One Who Desires Chaos
episodes.synopsis: Aohara, Tanabe and the others approach Yuri to form an alliance. Mayuko and Kuon come to Sniper Mask's aid when he starts to lose his mind.

episodes.title: I Am Justice!
